skill.name: youtrack
skill.description: Guides agents through IdeaVim YouTrack issue workflows, including VIM ticket lookup, comments, tags, status updates, and release version tasks.
skill.summary: Manage IdeaVim YouTrack tickets, tags, comments, statuses, and release workflows.
skill.author: JetBrains

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown backtick and code-fence false positives, not executable Ruby or hidden shell substitution. The skill still documents YouTrack state-changing workflows, including release version deletion, without explicit approval guardrails. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: State-changing YouTrack actions lack explicit confirmation guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Require user approval before posting comments, changing tags, changing status, creating versions, or deleting versions.

remediation.issue: The delete release version workflow is documented without a safety warning.
remediation.suggestion: Mark delete-version as destructive and require project, version, and user intent verification before use.
Document least-privilege YouTrack tokens and state that token values must never be printed, logged, or shared.

semantic_findings.title: YouTrack State Changes Lack Approval Guardrails
semantic_findings.description: The skill documents commands that add comments, change tags, update statuses, create versions, and delete versions without explicit confirmation guidance. In an agent workflow, mistaken execution could alter issue tracker records or release metadata.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented workflows include multiple mutating YouTrack actions and a delete-version command, and no adjacent approval requirement is present. The risk is operational rather than malicious, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.value_statement: Teams working on IdeaVim need consistent YouTrack workflows instead of GitHub Issues. This skill gives agents the ticket conventions, commands, tags, and release steps for VIM issues.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the JetBrains YouTrack project URL and VIM ticket prefix.
Documents commands for adding comments, managing tags, and changing ticket status.
Shows how to fetch ticket details with an optional structured output flag.
Lists common IdeaVim tag IDs used in ticket workflows.
Provides release workflow commands for fix versions and release versions.
Explains when to use private comments for JetBrains team visibility.
limitations: Requires a valid YOUTRACK_TOKEN and the referenced repository scripts.
Focuses on IdeaVim tickets that use the VIM project prefix.
Does not validate YouTrack permissions, token scope, or project configuration.
Includes destructive release version guidance that should require manual approval.

use_cases.title: Triage IdeaVim Tickets
use_cases.description: Review VIM tickets, check details, and decide whether tags or comments are needed.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Release Updates
use_cases.description: Set fix versions, mark tickets ready to release, and manage release version records.

use_cases.title: Request Clarification Privately
use_cases.description: Add a pending clarification tag and prepare a private comment for the JetBrains team.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Ticket
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the YouTrack skill to fetch details for VIM-1234 and summarize status, assignee, tags, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Comment
prompt_templates.prompt: For VIM-1234, draft a concise public comment based on this analysis. Ask before posting it to YouTrack.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Clarification
prompt_templates.prompt: For VIM-1234, identify missing information, propose a private clarification comment, and recommend the pending clarification tag.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Release Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the linked VIM tickets for release 2.29.0, identify ready items, and propose status, tag, and fix-version changes for approval.

output_examples.input: Summarize VIM-1234 and recommend the next action.
output: Status, tags, and recent discussion reviewed.
Recommended next action: ask the maintainer for missing reproduction details.

output_examples.input: Prepare a private clarification request for VIM-1234.
output_examples.output: A private comment draft asks for the missing details. The pending clarification tag is recommended for approval before changes are made.

output_examples.input: Plan release updates for VIM tickets in version 2.29.0.
output_examples.output: Ready tickets are grouped for fix-version updates. Risky status or version changes are listed for human approval first.

best_practices: Confirm the ticket ID and project before changing YouTrack records.
Use private comments only when the content is intended for the JetBrains team.
Request approval before mutating tags, status, comments, or release versions.
anti_patterns: Do not use GitHub Issues for IdeaVim tickets when this workflow applies.
Do not expose YOUTRACK_TOKEN values in prompts, logs, comments, or output.
Do not delete release versions without explicit confirmation and version verification.

faq.question: What project does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports IdeaVim issues in JetBrains YouTrack, using tickets with the VIM prefix.

faq.question: Does it use GitHub Issues?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that IdeaVim uses YouTrack for issue tracking.

faq.question: What credential is required?
faq.answer: The referenced scripts require the YOUTRACK_TOKEN environment variable.

faq.question: Can it post private comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents a private comment flag for comments visible only to the JetBrains team.

faq.question: Can it manage release versions?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents fix-version updates and release version creation or deletion workflows.

faq.question: Should changes be approved first?
faq.answer: Yes. Users should approve comments, tags, statuses, and release version changes before execution.
